title: Landslide, United Republic of Tanzania, 8 December 2023 (LS20231208TZA)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Landslide, United Republic of Tanzania, 8 December 2023 (LS20231208TZA), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: LS20231208TZA**  This map illustrates satellite detected landslides in Hanang District, Manyara Region, Tanzania as observed from a Sentinel-2 acquired on 07 December 2023 at 11:11 local time.
Within the analyzed area of 4,000 ha, about 75 ha of landslides scars are observed.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).

HDX datasets:

- [Satellite detected landslide extent in Hanang District, Manyara Region, Tanzania as of 07 December 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/landslide-extent-in-hanang-district-manyara-region-tanzania-as-of-07-december-2023)
- [Satellite detected landslide extent in Mogitu & Ganana Ward, Hanang District, Tanzania as of 19 December 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/landslide-extent-in-mogitu-ganana-ward-hanang-district-tanzania-as-of-19-december-2023)
